commands: set -euo pipefail; LABEL=com.michal.local-agent; DOMAIN=gui/$(id -u); echo EMERGENCY_STOP_LOCAL_AGENT; launchctl print "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/tmp/local-agent-launchd-before.txt 2>&1 || true; launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/$LABEL"; sleep 2; if launchctl print "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/tmp/local-agent-launchd-after.txt 2>&1; then echo LOCAL_AGENT_STILL_LOADED; cat /tmp/local-agent-launchd-after.txt; exit 1; else echo LOCAL_AGENT_UNLOADED; fi
